note: Every entry is an intervention hypothesis linked to external evidence. HPI has not implemented, tested or validated any of them. Evidence summaries are HPI interpretations of abstract-level findings and are labelled as such.

items.title: Hands-on application and compliance assistance
items.description: Trained staff help eligible people complete and follow up applications in person or by phone.
items.hpiInterpretation: Abstract-level evidence suggests larger average receipt effects than information alone in several settings, at higher delivery cost.
potentialHarms: Privacy risks from handling personal documents
items.costNote: Staff-intensive; cost per additional verified recipient not established for any HPI context.
items.contextDependence: Depends on local rules, existing advice services and agency procedures.

items.title: Information and reminder outreach
items.description: Letters, messages or campaigns telling people about an entitlement and how to claim.
items.hpiInterpretation: Effects range from null to small; applications can rise without approvals or receipt.
items.costNote: Low unit cost; small or null effects mean cost per additional recipient may still be high.
items.contextDependence: Strongly dependent on targeting accuracy and the burden that remains after information.

items.title: Reducing procedural denials
items.description: Agency-side changes such as flexible interview scheduling or simplified verification.
items.hpiInterpretation: One linked trial reports higher approvals; this requires the administering agency to change its process.
potentialHarms: Error-rate concerns if verification is weakened without safeguards
items.contextDependence: Requires agency authority; not something an external organisation can implement alone.

items.title: Psychological-ownership framing
items.description: Framing benefits as earned or owned to reduce stigma.
items.hpiInterpretation: Linked evidence measures interest only; effect on verified receipt unknown.

items.title: Online eligibility simulators
items.hpiInterpretation: The linked trial found no significant effect on take-up. HPI does not build individual eligibility checkers.

items.title: Social energy tariffs
items.description: Discounted energy tariffs for eligible households.
items.hpiInterpretation: Linked studies report lower bills; one also reports lower consumption that may indicate underconsumption.
items.costNote: Public or utility cost; not estimated by HPI.
items.contextDependence: Tariff design, eligibility rules and energy market structure.

items.title: Insulation and fabric retrofits
items.description: Improving building fabric to reduce heat loss.
items.hpiInterpretation: Evidence ranges from warmth gains in randomised trials to realised savings well below costs in another evaluation.
items.costNote: Capital-intensive; one evaluation found costs about twice realised savings.
items.contextDependence: Climate, housing stock, tenure and installation quality.

items.title: Heating system upgrades
items.hpiInterpretation: One linked trial in health-targeted households reports symptom and absence improvements, not bill reductions.
potentialHarms: Higher running costs if energy prices rise

items.title: Energy advice and coaching
items.description: Advice on energy use, tariffs or small fixes.
items.hpiInterpretation: Mixed: one RCT reports lower use and bills; observational studies report associations; small advice measures are mixed.
items.contextDependence: Baseline consumption and whether households are already rationing.

items.title: Financial support for fuel costs
items.description: Grants or payments towards energy bills.
items.hpiInterpretation: Mostly nonrandomised studies report improved warmth or wellbeing; causal strength varies.

items.title: Graduation and economic inclusion packages
items.description: Combined assets, consumption support, training and coaching.
items.hpiInterpretation: Intensive packages improved consumption in most linked trial sites; a lighter version did not improve consumption.
items.costNote: Relatively intensive; not estimated by HPI.
items.contextDependence: Programme dose, markets and implementing capacity.

items.title: Capital grants and microenterprise support
items.description: Cash or asset grants, sometimes with training, for self-employment.
items.hpiInterpretation: Large medium-term gains in linked trials, with convergence at nine years in one trial.
potentialHarms: Business failure risk shifted to participants
items.costNote: Grant cost plus delivery; not estimated.

items.title: Vocational and apprenticeship training
items.description: Training for specific occupations, including trainer incentives.
items.hpiInterpretation: Some trials report durable gains; reviews find typical effects small and context-dependent.
potentialHarms: Training for jobs that do not exist locally

items.title: Job search and matching assistance
items.description: Helping jobseekers find and apply for vacancies.
items.hpiInterpretation: Typical effects small; one linked trial reports worse search and job quality with added matching.
items.contextDependence: Vacancy quality and labour market slack.

items.title: Industrial job offers
items.hpiInterpretation: The linked trial reports no durable earnings gain and increased health risks.
